Our method adapts PPO using a phase-conditioned critic, phase-gated reward functions, and a multi-phase reset curriculum to guide exploration. To support varied hardware, we employ a decoupled hierarchical control architecture that separates lower-level balancing dynamics from high-level phase execution. We demonstrate multi-stage loco-manipulation skills on hardware on both the Unitree G1 and a Boston Dynamics Spot equipped with a manipulator arm, and validate our design choices through ablations. Our approach enables the acquisition of complex loco-manipulation behaviors purely through environment interaction while directly incorporating high-level task structure into policy learning.
tldr: This paper extends PPO with a phase-conditioned critic, phase-gated rewards, and a multi-phase reset curriculum to train a single policy for long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrated on both a humanoid and a quadruped with an arm.
tldr_zh: 本文通过相位条件评论家、相位门控奖励和多阶段重置课程扩展了PPO，以训练单一策略完成长期操作任务，并在人形机器人和带臂四足机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 复杂的全身移动操控需要在单一的长时程任务中执行多种操作，如蹲伏、抓取和移动。虽然实现简单的拾取-放置行为已较为成熟，但扩展到复杂的长时程任务仍然困难重重。目前，这一挑战通常依赖人体运动数据及相应的人形平台来解决，这限制了平台的独立性，并引入了大量的数据处理开销。为此，我们扩展了近端策略优化（PPO）算法，以在不同机器人硬件上训练适用于多阶段任务的单一策略，并利用先验任务结构来塑造行为。我们的方法通过相位条件评论家、相位门控奖励函数以及多阶段重置课程来调整PPO，从而引导探索过程。为支持多样化的硬件平台，我们采用了一种解耦的分层控制架构，将底层平衡动力学与高层相位执行分离开来。我们在Unitree G1以及配备机械臂的Boston Dynamics Spot上展示了多阶段移动操控技能，并通过消融实验验证了我们的设计选择。我们的方法使得仅通过环境交互即可习得复杂的移动操控行为，同时将高层任务结构直接融入策略学习之中。

title: Closed-Loop Aware Planning via Imitation-Free Speed Scoring for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has predominantly relied on open-loop imitation learning for training, which presents two limitations. First, expert demonstrations show only one behavior per scenario, so the model cannot learn alternative valid behaviors and, in turn, cannot adapt to user-specified preferences at test time. Second, noise or ambiguity in these demonstrations can produce inconsistent, unreliable supervision for the end-to-end models. Driving is inherently multi-modal: multiple different behaviors can be valid responses to the same scene, and this diversity arises largely from speed rather than path. We introduce a planning paradigm that learns the path through imitation while scoring a set of candidate speeds across multiple criteria with a learned function supervised by physically grounded safety constraints. We realize this paradigm as Closed-Loop Aware Planning for Autonomous Driving (CLAP-AD), a plug-in planning head that integrates with existing end-to-end driving models and, to our knowledge, is the first to enable explicit test-time control over their speed selection without speed-conditioned training. On Bench2Drive-Speed, CLAP-AD sets a new state of the art Speed-Adherence Score of 82.53, topping TFv6, the strongest baseline on this metric, by 12.9 points while retaining strong closed-loop driving performance. On Bench2Drive, it improves driving score by +28.5 and +32.7 over UniAD and VAD, and on NAVSIM v2, built on real-world driving data, EPDMS by +6.1 over its backbone. Project page: https://clap-ad.github.io
tldr: CLAP-AD is a plug-in planning head for end-to-end autonomous driving that learns path from imitation and scores candidate speeds with a learned function, enabling test-time speed control and improving closed-loop driving performance on Bench2Drive and NAVSIM v2.
tldr_zh: CLAP-AD是一个用于端到端自动驾驶的即插即用规划头，通过模仿学习路径并使用学习函数对候选速度进行评分，实现了测试时的速度控制，并在Bench2Drive和NAVSIM v2上提升了闭环驾驶性能。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶主要依赖开环模仿学习进行训练，这存在两个局限性。首先，专家示范在每个场景中仅展示一种行为，因此模型无法学习其他有效行为，进而在测试时无法适应用户指定的偏好。其次，这些示范中的噪声或歧义会产生不一致、不可靠的监督信号，影响端到端模型的训练效果。驾驶本质上是多模态的：同一场景可能存在多种不同的有效行为响应，且这种多样性主要源于速度而非路径。我们提出了一种规划范式，通过模仿学习路径，同时利用由物理基础安全约束监督的学习函数，对一组候选速度进行多标准评分。我们将该范式实现为自动驾驶闭环感知规划（CLAP-AD），这是一个即插即用的规划头模块，可集成到现有端到端驾驶模型中，并且据我们所知，这是首个无需速度条件训练即可在测试时实现对速度选择显式控制的方案。在Bench2Drive-Speed上，CLAP-AD以82.53的速度符合分数刷新了最先进水平，在该指标上比最强基线TFv6高出12.9分，同时保持强大的闭环驾驶性能。在Bench2Drive上，相较于UniAD和VAD，其驾驶分数分别提升了+28.5和+32.7；在基于真实驾驶数据构建的NAVSIM v2上，其EPDMS比骨干网络提升了+6.1。项目页面：https://clap-ad.github.io

title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video generative models for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual observations and actions. The visual prediction objective plays a key role in adapting pretrained video representations to the target robot domain. Yet standard visual prediction inherited from video pretraining treats all visual regions uniformly, despite their differing relevance to robotic control. We therefore investigate the spatial allocation of visual supervision in WAMs and show that focusing supervision on dynamic regions can substantially improve policy performance. Building on this finding, we introduce Motion-Guided Asymmetric Prediction (MoGAP), which augments WAM training with motion-focused visual prediction. MoGAP allocates noise asymmetrically across regions, training the model to reconstruct more heavily corrupted dynamic regions using less corrupted static regions as context. MoGAP is trained alongside standard video-action prediction through a training-only auxiliary prediction path within the shared video diffusion backbone. It uses motion cues derived directly from training videos, requiring neither an external teacher nor additional modalities. Across robot manipulation benchmarks and WAM architectures, MoGAP consistently improves policy performance, increasing success rates on the GR-1 tabletop benchmark from 38.8% to 47.5% for Fast-WAM (Wan2.2-5B) and from 52.3% to 62.3% for Cosmos3-Nano.
tldr: MoGAP improves World Action Models for robot control by focusing visual prediction supervision on dynamic regions through asymmetric noise corruption, enhancing policy performance on manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MoGAP 通过将视觉预测监督聚焦于动态区域，并采用非对称噪声破坏，提升了世界动作模型在机器人控制中的策略性能。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）利用预训练的视频生成模型进行机器人控制，通过联合预测未来的视觉观测和动作。视觉预测目标在将预训练视频表示适配到目标机器人领域方面发挥着关键作用。然而，从视频预训练中继承的标准视觉预测将所有视觉区域一视同仁地处理，尽管它们与机器人控制的相关性各不相同。因此，我们研究了WAMs中视觉监督的空间分配问题，并表明将监督聚焦于动态区域可以显著提升策略性能。基于这一发现，我们提出了运动引导的非对称预测（MoGAP），该方法通过运动聚焦的视觉预测来增强WAM训练。MoGAP在不同区域间非对称地分配噪声，训练模型利用噪声较少的静态区域作为上下文，重建噪声破坏更严重的动态区域。MoGAP通过共享视频扩散骨干网络中的训练专用辅助预测路径，与标准视频-动作预测联合训练。它直接利用训练视频中提取的运动线索，既不需要外部教师模型，也不需要额外的模态。在机器人操作基准测试和WAM架构上，MoGAP consistently提升了策略性能，将GR-1桌面基准上Fast-WAM（Wan2.2-5B）的成功率从38.8%提高到47.5%，将Cosmos3-Nano的成功率从52.3%提高到62.3%。

title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
summary: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.
tldr: GameVerse introduces a minute-scale gameplay dataset with 1,658 hours of footage, event-aligned captions, and stable camera trajectories, significantly extending the temporal coherence of interactive world models.
tldr_zh: GameVerse 提出了一个分钟级游戏数据集，包含1658小时视频、事件对齐标注和稳定相机轨迹，显著提升了交互式世界模型的时间连贯性。
summary_zh: 近期在交互式世界模型方面的进展使得从动作输入生成可控、动态环境成为可能。然而，现有模型在生成超过约一分钟的展开内容时难以保持连贯性，这一局限的根源并非模型容量，而在于长时间跨度训练数据的稀缺。现有的游戏视频数据集通常由时长不足十秒的片段组成，其标题以粗粒度、无区分性的文本描述整个片段，难以支撑可控的长时间跨度生成。为此，我们提出了GameVerse——一个专为长时间跨度交互式世界建模而构建的分钟级游戏视频数据集。GameVerse包含69.7K个片段，总时长1,655小时，共计3.496亿帧，涵盖多样化的第一人称和第三人称游戏画面，其中包含1,358小时的连续两分钟序列，比现有数据集长一个数量级。所有片段均经过统一的流水线处理，包括场景一致性分割、质量过滤、相机位姿估计和基于事件的标题标注。每个片段都配有时序稳定的相机轨迹，可在数分钟内保持连贯，同时标题将静态场景上下文与动态前景事件分离，并与事件边界对齐，而非固定时间窗口。综合分析表明，GameVerse在规模、多样性和标注质量上均超越现有公开数据集。实验进一步证明，在GameVerse上训练可显著延长交互式世界模型的时间范围。

title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
summary: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.
tldr: Hy-Nomas is an 8B diffusion-based video world model that generates interactive, free-form video segments by conditioning on text instructions and camera control, using a high-quality video captioner, a vision-language prompt enhancer, and a multi-stage curriculum. It demonstrates superior performance in human evaluation for multi-turn interactive world generation.
tldr_zh: Hy-Nomas 是一个基于80亿参数扩散骨干的视频世界模型，通过文本指令和相机控制生成自由形式的交互式视频片段，采用高质量视频描述器、视觉语言提示增强器及多阶段课程训练，在人机交互式世界生成评测中表现优于现有模型。
summary_zh: 交互式世界生成要求模型在遵循连续指令的同时，保留相关历史信息与行为后果。我们提出Hy-Nomas，一个基于8B扩散主干网络的视频世界模型，支持自由形式文本指令及跨多轮交互的连续摄像机控制。该模型根据当前输入与缓存历史生成可变长度片段。我们的核心设计将结构化视频字幕与行为感知的因果注意力对齐：描述性上下文在片段间保持可访问，而行为指令则被限制在其预期的时间窗口内。一种视觉-语言提示增强器（PE）将用户请求和多模态交互历史转换为下一片段的结构化条件。多阶段课程依次引入因果生成、文本交互、摄像机控制以及基于模型生成历史的训练，随后进行扩散蒸馏。在人工评估中，Hy-Nomas展现出优于现有世界模型的性能。我们公开模型权重、代码与基准测试，并附带轻量级适配工作流，以支持交互式世界生成的可复现研究。

title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
summary: Low-cost arms such as the SO-101 have become the most common entry point to robot learning, yet no released policy performs spatially constrained, language-conditioned tasks on them out of the box, and existing SO-101 benchmarks run only on physical hardware with simple tasks and few held-out objects. We introduce SO-101 Bench, a simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation built on an Isaac Lab digital twin of a real SO-101 setup. It has four tasks scored as five families, 138 objects in seen, unseen-instance and unseen-class splits, 916 evaluation episodes with subsets for held-out appearances, rotate-to-fit planning and occlusion memory, and 3,629 simulated demonstrations on which every learned policy is fine-tuned under an equal compute budget. The twin ranks policies as the real robot does: five policies trained without real data, four VLAs and an LLM agent, keep their exact ranking when the same weights run on the physical arm in an unseen environment with unseen objects (Spearman rho = 1.00, MMRV = 0.000), although simulation overestimates success. Across nine VLAs and world-action models, the best learned policies score near 61%, with spatial placement, unseen object classes and rotate-to-fit planning remaining open. An LLM agent that writes code and hands grasping to a learned policy scores 83.2%, and an ablation shows that this lead comes from the choice of harness and the choice of language model.
tldr: SO-101 Bench provides a simulated Isaac Lab benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation on low-cost SO-101 arms, with 138 objects and 916 evaluation episodes. Experiments show that simulated policy rankings match real-robot rankings exactly, and top learned policies reach ~61% success while an LLM agent with a learned grasping policy achieves 83.2%.
tldr_zh: SO-101 Bench 在 Isaac Lab 中为低成本 SO-101 机械臂构建了一个语言条件空间操作仿真基准，包含 138 个物体和 916 个评估片段。实验表明仿真中的策略排名与真实机器人完全一致，最佳学习策略达到约 61% 的成功率，而结合 LLM 智能体与学习抓取策略的方法达到 83.2%。
summary_zh: 低成本机械臂（如SO-101）已成为机器人学习最普遍的入门平台，然而目前尚无任何已发布的策略能够开箱即用地在其上执行受空间约束的语言条件任务，且现有SO-101基准仅在物理硬件上运行，任务简单且留出对象稀少。我们提出SO-101 Bench，一个基于真实SO-101装置Isaac Lab数字孪生的语言条件空间操作模拟基准。该基准包含四个任务，按五个家族评分，涵盖138个对象（分为已见、未见实例和未见类别三种划分），916个评估片段（包含留出外观、旋转适配规划和遮挡记忆子集），以及3,629条模拟演示，所有学习策略在同等计算预算下基于这些演示进行微调。数字孪生体与真实机器人对策略的排序一致：五种未使用真实数据训练的策略、四种视觉语言模型（VLA）和一个LLM智能体，在相同权重部署于物理机械臂且面对未见环境与未见对象时，保持了完全相同的排名（Spearman rho = 1.00，MMRV = 0.000），尽管模拟会高估成功率。在九种VLA和世界动作模型（world-action models）中，最佳学习策略得分接近61%，而空间放置、未见对象类别和旋转适配规划仍为开放问题。一个编写代码并将抓取交由学习策略执行的LLM智能体得分达83.2%，消融实验表明，这一领先优势源于对控制框架（harness）和语言模型的选择。

title: Structured Representation Probing for Risk Anticipation in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving policies form structured internal representations of traffic, ego behavior, and road constraints. These representations offer a monitoring interface for anticipating failures, complementing risk signals from trajectories, controls, and manually designed features. We introduce the Structured Representation Probe (SRP), a lightweight monitor that reads actor, ego, and map representations from a frozen policy. SRP learns a separate linear risk direction for each source and aggregates element scores through cardinality-normalized log-mean-exp pooling, retaining sensitivity to salient evidence while reducing dependence on token count. Event-window supervision links the readout to upcoming hard failures, and auxiliary event type heads jointly train the source directions across failure modes. Online alerting uses a single generic score without modifying the driving policy. Bench2Drive experiments on DriveTransformer, UniAD, and VAD show higher frame-level PR-AUC and ROC-AUC than the evaluated runtime baselines. On DriveTransformer at a horizon of 2 seconds, ROC-AUC reaches 0.833 versus 0.715 for temporal consistency, with 2.67% readout runtime overhead. The trained probes also retain the ability to distinguish impending failures on new routes.
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight Structured Representation Probe (SRP) that reads internal representations from frozen end-to-end driving policies to anticipate hard failures, achieving higher frame-level PR-AUC and ROC-AUC than runtime baselines on Bench2Drive with minimal overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级结构化表征探针（SRP），从冻结的端到端驾驶策略中读取内部表征以预测困难故障，在Bench2Drive上相较于运行时基线实现了更高的帧级PR-AUC和ROC-AUC，且开销极小。
summary_zh: 端到端驾驶策略能够形成对交通、自我车辆行为及道路约束的结构化内部表征。这些表征为预测失败提供了一种监测接口，可补充来自轨迹、控制及人工设计特征的风险信号。我们提出了结构化表征探针（SRP），这是一种轻量级监测器，能够从冻结策略中读取参与者、自我车辆及地图表征。SRP为每个数据源学习独立的线性风险方向，并通过基数归一化的对数均值指数池化聚合各元素得分，从而在保持对显著证据敏感性的同时，降低对令牌数量的依赖。事件窗口监督将读取结果与即将发生的硬失败相关联，辅助事件类型头则联合训练各风险方向以覆盖不同失败模式。在线警报使用单一通用得分，且无需修改驾驶策略。基于DriveTransformer、UniAD和VAD的Bench2Drive实验表明，该方法在帧级PR-AUC和ROC-AUC上均优于所评估的运行时基线。在2秒预测时域下，DriveTransformer的ROC-AUC达到0.833，而时间一致性方法为0.715，读取运行时开销仅为2.67%。训练后的探针在新路线上仍能保持区分即将发生失败的能力。

title: Learning Visuomotor Quadrotor Flight Through Dynamic Narrow Gaps via Differentiable Simulation
summary: Threading a quadrotor through a moving narrow gap is a demanding test of agile flight, requiring centimeter-level spatial alignment and precise temporal execution. We address this challenge using a control policy that operates directly on onboard visual and inertial measurements to output collective thrust and body-rate commands. The task is difficult because success lies on a thin feasible manifold: small errors in timing, position, attitude, or visual observability cause collision. Prior planning and learning methods rely on privileged state, teachers, planners, or distillation; learning dynamic narrow-gap traversal directly, from scratch, remains open. We introduce a differentiable moving-gap formulation that gates centering, alignment, and smooth collision terms by signed distance to a time-varying gap plane, turning a sparse traversal event into a dense pathwise objective. We integrate this formulation into a visual-feature-to-command policy trained in one stage from random initialization, without a teacher, planner, or distillation. We validate our approach in both synthetic and real-world experiments. In controlled benchmarks, we demonstrate that pathwise gradients significantly outperform score-function gradients for precision-critical tasks, yielding a 99.3% success rate in simulation after only a few minutes of training on a single GPU. Furthermore, the policy transfers directly to a real quadrotor, successfully crossing a dynamic narrow gap from varied initial conditions using onboard sensing and inertial measurements, achieving an 80% success rate over 10 physical trials.
tldr: This paper presents a differentiable simulation-based method for training a visuomotor quadrotor policy to fly through dynamic narrow gaps, achieving high success in simulation and direct real-world transfer without a teacher or planner.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于可微仿真的方法，训练视觉运动四旋翼策略穿越动态窄间隙，在仿真中取得高成功率，并无需教师或规划器即可直接迁移到真实世界。
summary_zh: 让四旋翼飞行器穿过移动的狭窄间隙，是对敏捷飞行的严苛考验，需要厘米级的空间对齐和精确的时间执行。我们通过一种直接基于机载视觉和惯性测量输出总推力和机体角速率指令的控制策略来应对这一挑战。该任务的难点在于成功仅存在于一条狭窄的可行流形上：时间、位置、姿态或视觉可观测性上的微小误差都会导致碰撞。以往的规划与学习方法依赖于特权状态、教师模型、规划器或知识蒸馏；而直接从零开始学习动态窄间隙穿越，仍然是一个未解决的问题。我们提出了一种可微分的移动间隙模型，通过符号距离函数对时变间隙平面进行门控，将居中、对齐和平滑碰撞项整合起来，从而将稀疏的穿越事件转化为密集的路径目标。我们将该模型集成到一个从随机初始化开始、无需教师模型、规划器或知识蒸馏的单阶段训练视觉特征到控制指令的策略中。我们在合成环境与真实世界实验中均验证了该方法。在受控基准测试中，我们证明对于精度关键型任务，路径梯度显著优于评分函数梯度，在单块GPU上仅需数分钟训练即可在仿真中达到99.3%的成功率。此外，该策略可直接迁移至真实四旋翼飞行器，利用机载感知与惯性测量从多种初始条件下成功穿越动态狭窄间隙，在10次物理试验中实现了80%的成功率。

title: Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Manipulation policies are evaluated predominantly by binary task success, which cannot tell whether the commanded gesture is the one the object's kinematics admit. We introduce Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS), which projects the commanded end-effector twist onto the object's joint axis, separating progress along the joint from off-constraint waste. CRS requires a joint model and a joint-following scripted controller derived from it, but no recorded demonstration or learned judge. On 74 simulated articulated objects, success registers three transfer failures as lower rates but attributes none, while the two CRS channels give each a distinct signature. A door-trained behavior-cloning policy opens drawers in 59 of 110 episodes, and in these passes it commands about $40\times$ the off-axis rotation of a drawer-trained policy's passes ($1.27$ vs.\ $0.032$~rad/s). Relative to a scripted controller scored with the same axis, CRS verdicts are unchanged under joint-axis errors up to $30^\circ$; absolute thresholds tolerate about $8^\circ$.
tldr: This paper introduces a Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS) for evaluating articulated object manipulation policies by projecting commanded end-effector twists onto the object's joint axis, separating progress from off-constraint waste, providing more informative metrics than binary success.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种约束参考策略（CRS），通过将命令的末端执行器扭转向物体关节轴投影，分离沿关节的进展与偏离约束的浪费，为关节物体操作策略提供了比二元成功更信息丰富的评估指标。
summary_zh: 操作策略的评估主要依据二元任务成功与否，这无法判断所指令的手势是否与物体运动学所允许的一致。我们引入了约束参考策略（CRS），该方法将指令的末端执行器旋量投影到物体的关节轴上，从而将沿关节的进展与偏离约束的浪费区分开来。CRS需要一个关节模型以及基于该模型推导出的关节跟踪脚本控制器，但无需记录演示或学习判别器。在74个模拟铰接物体上，成功指标将三次迁移失败记录为较低的比率，但无法归因于具体原因，而CRS的两个通道各自呈现出独特的特征。一个以门为训练对象的行为克隆策略在110个回合中有59个回合成功打开了抽屉，在这些成功回合中，指令的离轴旋转量约为以抽屉为训练对象策略的40倍（1.27对0.032弧度/秒）。相对于使用同一轴评分的脚本控制器，CRS的判定在关节轴误差高达30度时保持不变；绝对阈值约可容忍8度的偏差。

title: Which Hand Was Late? Diagnosis for Robot Failure Recovery in Bimanual Tool Use
summary: Failure diagnosers for robot manipulation are increasingly vision--language models (VLMs), trained and evaluated on single-arm failures produced by perturbing a successful demonstration. Bimanual tool use adds failures of other kinds: a tool that slips out of its socket while still held, two correct gestures made at different times, and attempts that fail for two reasons at once. On a simulated bimanual tool-use task whose failure causes are read from the recorded trace, we measure what each sensing channel lets a diagnoser tell. The tool's slip is read on the tool hand; which hand was late is read on both arms, while a sensor on one hand reads its own hand's delay and at most part of the other's; and whether a late attempt was also pushed too weakly is not identifiable from passive sensing when the tool hand is late. Within two attempts, a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable repairs as many failures as one told the true cause. A VLM's internal state carries the late hand almost perfectly, along a direction no closer to the one its answer reads than a random one; whether the answer reports it depends on the wording of the question.
tldr: This paper investigates failure diagnosis in bimanual tool use using vision-language models, finding that the tool slip is readable on the tool hand, the late hand is identifiable from both arms, and a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable matches the performance of an oracle. It also reveals that a VLM's internal state encodes the late hand but its answer depends on question wording.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了双手工具使用中的故障诊断，发现工具滑动可在工具手上读取，迟手可从双臂识别，且在原因不可识别时采用升级策略的修复策略与知道真实原因的策略性能相当。同时揭示了VLM内部状态编码了迟手信息，但其回答取决于问题措辞。
summary_zh: 机器人操作中的故障诊断器日益采用视觉-语言模型（VLMs），这些模型通过在扰动成功演示所产生的单臂故障上进行训练和评估。双臂工具使用则引入了其他类型的故障：工具在仍被握持时从插槽中滑出、两个正确动作在不同时间发生，以及因两个原因同时导致的失败尝试。在一个模拟的双臂工具使用任务中，其故障原因从记录轨迹中读取，我们测量了每个感知通道能让诊断器辨别出什么信息。工具的滑脱由工具手读取；哪只手延迟则从双臂上读取，而一只手上的传感器只能读取自身手的延迟及对方手的部分延迟；此外，当工具手延迟时，一次延迟尝试是否也推力过弱，无法通过被动感知加以识别。在两次尝试内，当原因不可识别时采用升级策略的修复策略，其修复的故障数量与被告知真实原因的修复策略相同。VLM的内部状态几乎完美地携带了延迟手的信息，其方向与答案读取方向的距离并不比随机方向更近；答案是否报告这一信息则取决于问题的措辞。

title: Ego-CEVR: Learning Cross-Embodiment Visual Representations from Human Egocentric Videos
summary: As egocentric video becomes increasingly available for embodied learning, an important research question is how to turn this low-cost, scalable source of data into robot manipulation capabilities. Egocentric videos naturally provide rich context for high-level task understanding, while real-robot demonstrations with wrist observations and action annotations provide supervision for fine-grained action alignment. We present Ego-CEVR, a data-native framework for hierarchical visual representation learning that assigns distinct learning objectives to global and interaction representations. The global module learns object relations, task state, and temporal progress through future prediction on egocentric video. The Interaction module interprets wrist observations in global context and learns local alignment and contact cues through robot action supervision. Separate residual paths expose both representations to the action policy, preserving direct access to task context alongside fine-grained execution information. Ego-CEVR supports independent pretraining of its global video module on large-scale human egocentric videos and videos from diverse robot embodiments, without requiring robot action labels or paired wrist observations.
tldr: Ego-CEVR introduces a hierarchical visual representation learning framework that pretrains a global video module on large-scale human egocentric and robot videos for task understanding, while an interaction module uses wrist observations and robot action supervision for fine-grained control, enabling cross-embodiment robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: Ego-CEVR 提出了一种分层视觉表示学习框架，通过在大规模人类自我中心视频和机器人视频上预训练全局视频模块来理解任务，同时利用腕部观测和机器人动作监督来学习精细控制，从而实现跨本体的机器人操作。
summary_zh: 随着自我中心视频在具身学习中日益普及，一个重要的研究问题是如何将这种低成本、可扩展的数据源转化为机器人操作能力。自我中心视频天然地为高层任务理解提供了丰富的上下文，而带有腕部观测和动作标注的真实机器人演示则为细粒度动作对齐提供了监督信号。我们提出了Ego-CEVR，一种面向数据的层级视觉表示学习框架，该框架为全局表示和交互表示分配了不同的学习目标。全局模块通过自我中心视频上的未来预测来学习物体关系、任务状态和时间进度。交互模块在全局上下文中解读腕部观测，并通过机器人动作监督学习局部对齐和接触线索。独立的残差路径将两种表示均暴露给动作策略，在保留细粒度执行信息的同时，保持对任务上下文的直接访问。Ego-CEVR支持其全局视频模块在大规模人类自我中心视频和来自不同机器人形态的视频上进行独立预训练，且无需机器人动作标签或配对的腕部观测数据。

title: Autonomous fixed-wing interception using reinforcement learning
summary: Medium altitude, long endurance unmanned aerial systems such as Shahed-type strike drones are an unanswered threat in modern conflicts. Conventional air defense systems are too expensive to provide a feasible large-scale solution. Quadcopter interceptors are a cheap, battle-proven alternative, but their extremely limited flight time restricts them to low altitude targets at short range, whereas fixed-wing platforms have the endurance to reach higher altitude targets from longer distances. However, such interceptors are still operated manually. Recent developments in learning-based controllers show potential for automation. In this work, a fixed-wing interceptor is presented that is controlled by a neural network that maps filtered monocular vision observations directly to actuator commands. The policy was trained in a custom Python environment using reinforcement learning and proximal policy optimization. The policy was then deployed on a fixed-wing platform and tested in real interception scenarios. As a baseline, two classical guidance controllers were also developed and tested in simulation. The policy is able to intercept targets both in simulation and in real flight. In simulation, the policy outperforms the classical controllers under most conditions. The interceptor was ultimately successfully validated in real flight by intercepting maneuvering fixed-wing targets. This novel system shows the potential of artificial intelligence for autonomous control of fixed-wing interceptor drones.
tldr: This paper presents a fixed-wing interceptor drone controlled by a reinforcement learning policy that maps monocular vision to actuator commands, demonstrating successful interception in both simulation and real flight.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种由强化学习策略控制的固定翼拦截无人机，该策略将单目视觉映射到执行器命令，并在仿真和真实飞行中成功实现了拦截。
summary_zh: 中空长航时无人机系统，如“沙赫德”型攻击无人机，在现代冲突中构成了一项尚未解决的威胁。传统防空系统成本过高，难以提供可行的大规模解决方案。四旋翼拦截无人机是一种廉价且经过实战验证的替代方案，但其极为有限的飞行时间使其仅能应对低空、近距离目标，而固定翼平台则具备从更远距离抵达更高空目标的续航能力。然而，此类拦截机目前仍需人工操作。近年来，基于学习的控制器的发展展现出自动化的潜力。本研究提出了一种固定翼拦截机，其由神经网络控制，该网络直接将滤波后的单目视觉观测映射至执行器指令。策略在自定义Python环境中通过强化学习和近端策略优化进行训练，随后部署于固定翼平台并接受真实拦截场景测试。作为基线，另开发了两种经典制导控制器并在仿真中进行了测试。该策略在仿真和实际飞行中均能成功拦截目标。在仿真中，该策略在多数条件下优于经典控制器。最终，该拦截机通过拦截机动固定翼目标在真实飞行中得以成功验证。这一新颖系统展示了人工智能在固定翼拦截无人机自主控制方面的潜力。

title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
summary: Robot policy evaluation often relies on a binary success signal for task completion. In real-world deployment, however, desired execution behaviors are also defined by quality attributes such as execution speed and motion smoothness, which need to be dynamically controlled according to task requirements. To address this, we introduce Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), a robot policy that enables inference-time control over both individual quality attributes and their combinations. To extend the controllable quality range beyond initial demonstrations, we further propose an iterative hindsight relabeling loop: QCP collects online rollouts under target quality labels, adds successful trajectories to the dataset, relabels the accumulated trajectories in hindsight according to their measured quality, and fine-tunes the policy. Experiments on Robomimic and RoboEval demonstrate that QCP consistently improves both task execution quality and success rates across iterations, producing successful rollouts that exceed the quality of the initial demonstrations. Finally, we validate QCP on real-world manipulation tasks, where controlling speed increases throughput in conveyor operations and controlling transport stability improves success when carrying wine glasses, demonstrating that quality-controllable policies yield practical gains in physical deployment.
tldr: The paper introduces Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), a robot policy that enables inference-time control over quality attributes like speed and smoothness, and uses iterative hindsight relabeling to extend controllable quality ranges beyond initial demonstrations. Experiments on Robomimic, RoboEval, and real-world manipulation tasks show improved task execution quality and success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出质量可控策略（QCP），使得机器人策略能够在推理时控制速度和平滑度等质量属性，并通过迭代事后重标注来扩展可控质量范围。在Robomimic、RoboEval及真实操作任务上的实验表明，该方法能提升任务执行质量和成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人策略评估通常依赖于任务完成的二元成功信号。然而，在实际部署中，期望的执行行为还由质量属性定义，如执行速度和运动平滑度，这些属性需要根据任务要求进行动态控制。为解决这一问题，我们引入了质量可控策略（QCP），这是一种机器人策略，能够在推理时控制单个质量属性及其组合。为了将可控质量范围扩展到初始演示之外，我们进一步提出了一种迭代式事后重新标记循环：QCP在目标质量标签下收集在线轨迹，将成功轨迹添加到数据集中，根据其测量质量对累积轨迹进行事后重新标记，并对策略进行微调。在Robomimic和RoboEval上的实验表明，QCP在多次迭代中持续提高了任务执行质量和成功率，产生的成功轨迹超越了初始演示的质量。最后，我们在真实世界的操作任务中验证了QCP，其中控制速度提高了传送带作业的吞吐量，控制运输稳定性提高了搬运酒杯时的成功率，证明了质量可控策略在实际部署中带来了切实的收益。

title: Generalizable Target-Less Joint Intrinsic-Extrinsic Camera-LiDAR Calibration using Deep Pixel-Point Correspondences
summary: Accurate camera-LiDAR calibration is an essential prerequisite for robust multi-modal perception in robotics. Recent target-less methods based on learned pixel-point correspondences achieve high extrinsic calibration accuracy and generalize across environments. However, they operate on rectified images with known camera intrinsics, restricting their applicability to systems whose cameras have already been individually calibrated. We present a fully automatic, target-less framework that jointly estimates camera intrinsics, radial-tangential distortion, and camera-LiDAR extrinsics from raw images and LiDAR scans. Our method generalizes deep correspondence-based calibration from rectified images to raw cameras through intrinsic- and distortion-aware correspondence learning via synthetic augmentations. During calibration, we iteratively couple correspondence prediction and nonlinear optimization to jointly refine the camera parameters and relative sensor transformation. We evaluate our approach on an unseen camera-LiDAR configuration from the KITTI dataset and on three real robotic platforms in a zero-shot manner. The results demonstrate that joint calibration with our generalized pixel-point correspondence network improves extrinsic accuracy over correspondence-based methods using pre-calibrated cameras, while additionally recovering accurate intrinsics.
tldr: This paper presents a fully automatic, target-less framework for joint camera intrinsic, distortion, and camera-LiDAR extrinsic calibration using deep pixel-point correspondences, enabling calibration on raw images without prior intrinsic knowledge, and demonstrating improved accuracy over pre-calibrated methods on KITTI and real robotic platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个全自动、无标靶的相机-LiDAR联合标定框架，通过深度像素-点对应关系同时估计相机内参、畸变和外参，无需预先内参标定，并在KITTI及真实机器人平台上验证了优于预标定方法的精度。
summary_zh: 精确的相机-激光雷达标定是机器人多模态感知鲁棒性的关键前提。近年来，基于所学像素-点对应关系的无目标方法在外部参数标定上取得了较高精度，并能跨环境泛化。然而，这些方法基于已知相机内参的校正图像，限制了其在相机尚未单独标定系统中的应用。我们提出了一种全自动、无目标的框架，可从原始图像和激光雷达扫描中联合估计相机内参、径向-切向畸变以及相机-激光雷达外部参数。该方法通过合成增强实现内参与畸变感知的对应关系学习，将基于深度对应关系的标定方法从校正图像推广至原始相机。标定过程中，我们迭代耦合对应关系预测与非线性优化，以联合优化相机参数及传感器间相对变换。我们在KITTI数据集上的未见相机-激光雷达配置及三个真实机器人平台上进行了零样本评估。结果表明，与基于预标定相机的对应关系方法相比，所提联合标定方法借助广义像素-点对应关系网络提升了外部参数精度，同时还能恢复精确的内参。

title: KEPT: Conformal Keepouts Kept in Planning for Enclosed-Space Navigation in Degraded Sensing
summary: Autonomous vehicles in enclosed spaces such as tunnels and mines rely on range maps that smoke, dust and fog make inaccurate. Conformal prediction calibrates a keepout around the mapped walls that covers the true unsafe set at a chosen probability. Typically an unmodified planner treats the keepout as an inflated obstacle, and nothing ensures that the vehicle can stop before the keepout as it moves when sensing degrades. In narrow passages this margin and the planner's buffer close the route, and existing remedies recover reach by relaxing the coverage level. This paper conditions the conformal margin on a label-free severity estimate to hold coverage near its target as degradation varies. A planning and control layer enforces one braking-distance condition on the keepout at plan time and at every command, takes the measured tracking residual as its only margin and never alters the keepout. The keepout is validated on ground-robot smoke recordings and the closed loop in simulated quadrotor flights in a foggy tunnel against the standard deployment. In closed-loop simulation the proposed system substantially reduces entries into the calibrated keepout and reaches numerically more goals than the deployment pattern in both calibration regimes, an observed gain of 3.2 percentage points pooled whose per-regime confidence intervals include zero. The per-class keepout holds its coverage near the target on held-out recordings.
tldr: This paper presents a conformal keepout planning method for enclosed-space navigation under degraded sensing, conditioning the safety margin on a severity estimate and enforcing a braking-distance condition at planning and control time to improve safety and goal reachability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在感知退化条件下用于封闭空间导航的共形保持区规划方法，将安全边际条件化于严重性估计，并在规划和控制时强制执行制动距离条件，以提高安全性和目标可达性。
summary_zh: 隧道和矿井等封闭空间中的自主车辆依赖于距离地图，而烟雾、灰尘和雾霾会使这些地图变得不精确。保形预测会在测绘墙体周围校准一个安全禁区，以选定的概率覆盖真实的不安全区域。通常，未经修改的规划器会将安全禁区视为膨胀的障碍物，且没有机制确保当感知能力下降时，车辆能在进入安全禁区前停下。在狭窄通道中，这一安全裕度与规划器的缓冲会阻断路径，而现有的补救措施通过放宽覆盖水平来恢复可达性。本文根据一种无标签的严重性估计来调节保形裕度，使覆盖水平在退化程度变化时保持接近目标值。规划与控制层在规划时刻及每个指令执行时，对安全禁区实施一个基于制动距离的条件，仅以实测跟踪残差作为其唯一裕度，且从未改变安全禁区本身。该安全禁区在地面机器人的烟雾记录数据上得到验证，并在模拟四旋翼飞行器穿越有雾隧道的闭环中与标准部署方式进行了对比。在闭环仿真中，所提出的系统显著减少了对校准安全禁区的侵入，并在两种校准机制下均实现了比标准部署方式更高的数值目标达成率，合并观察增益为3.2个百分点，而各机制下的置信区间包含零。分类型安全禁区在留出记录上保持了接近目标值的覆盖水平。

title: Remember Where You Walk: Learning Spatial Memory for End-to-End Legged Robot Exploration
summary: Humanoids and other legged robots operating in complex environments must remember information that leaves their field of view and only becomes relevant much later. Reinforcement learning policies address this using memory networks such as LSTMs that are trained end-to-end with the policy to memorize such task-relevant aspects. Yet, such architectures often fail to preserve sufficient information over long horizons. In this work, we propose a network architecture based on Hadamard memory that specifically targets robot navigation. Our Local Spatial Matrix Memory (LSMM) enables RL agents to store generic task-relevant information at specific, position-based memory cells, enabling flexible and spatially grounded memorization. We evaluate LSMM on the task of autonomous maze exploration, where it matches the maze coverage of strong recurrent and finite-history baselines while being the only architecture that remembers the maze layout, reducing the reconstruction error threefold.
tldr: This paper introduces Local Spatial Matrix Memory (LSMM), a Hadamard-based memory architecture for end-to-end legged robot exploration, enabling spatially grounded memorization that improves maze layout recall without sacrificing coverage.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了局部空间矩阵记忆（LSMM），一种基于阿达玛记忆的网络架构，用于端到端腿式机器人探索，通过空间定位的记忆单元增强长时记忆，在保持迷宫覆盖率的同时将重建误差降低三倍。
summary_zh: 人形机器人及其他腿式机器人在复杂环境中作业时，必须记住那些超出视野范围、且直到很久之后才变得相关的信息。强化学习策略通常借助LSTM等记忆网络来解决这一问题，这类网络与策略进行端到端联合训练，以记忆此类任务关键信息。然而，这类架构往往难以在长时间跨度内保留足够的信息。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于Hadamard记忆的网络架构，专门针对机器人导航任务设计。我们的局部空间矩阵记忆（LSMM）使强化学习智能体能够将通用的任务相关信息存储于基于位置的具体记忆单元中，从而实现灵活且具有空间锚定性的记忆功能。我们在自主迷宫探索任务上对LSMM进行了评估，结果表明，其迷宫覆盖率可与强大的循环网络基线及有限历史基线相媲美，同时是唯一能够记住迷宫布局的架构，将重建误差降低了三倍。

title: A Bi-level Co-design Framework for Lunar Monoped with 2D Jump and Landing Control
summary: Legged robots for lunar exploration must be designed for low gravity, where reduced contact forces and long flight phases make leg morphology and controller choice interdependent. We study this for a planar monoped in lunar gravity ($1.625$ m/s$^2$) using a bi-level co-design framework: a differential evolution outer loop searches over link lengths, and each candidate is evaluated on a vertical jump by either a quadratic program based task-space controller (QP-TSC) or a direct-collocation based trajectory optimization. The two controllers yield different optimal link lengths, and trajectory optimization outperforms the QP-TSC across most of the design space, with 17% lower Cost of Transport (COT) at their respective optima. We then extend to a 2D jump, where trajectory optimization with centroidal angular momentum regulation produces stable in-place and forward jumps, and an LQR controller absorbs impact and stabilizes the robot after touchdown. This is demonstrated on a baseline morphology with both links 0.3 m long.
tldr: This paper presents a bi-level co-design framework for a lunar monoped robot, jointly optimizing leg link lengths and control strategies for jumping and landing in low gravity, demonstrating that trajectory optimization outperforms a QP-based task-space controller and extends to stable 2D jumps with LQR impact absorption.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种月球单足跳跃机器人的双层协同设计框架，联合优化腿部连杆长度与控制策略，以实现在低重力环境下的跳跃与落地稳定，并证明轨迹优化优于基于QP的任务空间控制器，且可扩展至稳定的二维跳跃。
summary_zh: 月球探测用腿式机器人必须针对低重力环境进行设计，在低重力条件下，接触力减小、飞行阶段延长，这使得腿部形态与控制器选择相互依存。本研究针对月球重力（$1.625$ m/s²）下的平面单足机器人，采用双层协同设计框架对此进行探究：差分进化外层循环搜索连杆长度，每个候选方案通过基于二次规划的任务空间控制器（QP-TSC）或基于直接配点法的轨迹优化，在垂直跳跃中进行评估。两种控制器产生了不同的最优连杆长度，且在大部分设计空间中，轨迹优化的表现优于QP-TSC，在各自最优解处，其运输成本（COT）降低了17%。随后，我们将研究扩展到二维跳跃场景，其中基于质心角动量调节的轨迹优化能够产生稳定的原地跳跃和前向跳跃，LQR控制器在落地后吸收冲击并稳定机器人。这一功能在基线形态（两段连杆长度均为0.3 m）上得到了验证。

title: How Much Can Best-of-N Help a World Action Model? Measuring Selectable Headroom and Realizing It in Closed Loop
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces a denoised counterfactual protocol to measure the selectable headroom of best-of-N selection for world action models, and builds a fail-gated selector that improves closed-loop task success by using imagined futures to avoid predicted failures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种去噪反事实协议，用于衡量世界动作模型在最佳N选一策略中的可选择余量，并构建了一个失败门控选择器，通过利用想象中的未避免预测的失败，从而提升闭环任务成功率。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）能够预测其生成动作的视觉后果，这使得测试时选择成为改进固定策略的自然途径：想象候选动作的未来结果，并执行最优者。选择收益受限于可选余量，即最优候选的真实优势程度，但标准估计方法——对每个候选执行一次并保留最佳结果——将候选质量与后续所有环节的随机性混为一谈。我们提出了一种基于按位可复现分支、重复延续、留出预言机以及公共随机数的去噪反事实协议，用于衡量选择器能够实现的可选余量，并利用其测量结果构建了一个失败门控选择器。在四种WAM、两个基准、超过100,000次分支展开以及预注册测试中，我们发现：（i）标准估计高估了原生样本的可选余量：每个候选17次延续的界限表明，三种WAM的可选份额介于24%至66%之间；（ii）结构化动作扰动可创造出多达16个百分点的可选余量；（iii）在具有动作条件想象的两个WAM中，想象未来相对于真实未来携带候选结果信息，且没有可检测的损失，而Cosmos Policy的值头却未利用这些信息。仅当WAM读出预测失败时才偏离策略块，该选择器将训练任务留出情节的闭环任务成功率从76.9%提升至81.6%，其中在策略最常失败的场景中提升最大，并将未见任务的成功率从62.6%提升至69.8%。

title: FastBEVFusion: Simple Multi-Modal Fusion for 3D Object Detection at 50 FPS
summary: Reliable real-time 3D object detection based on LiDAR and camera data is critical for safety in autonomous driving, where systems must accurately perceive their surroundings with minimal latency. Many state-of-the-art systems achieve high-quality detection results but fail to meet real-time constraints, limiting their practical use. To address this challenge, we propose FastBEVFusion, a simple, fast, and robust fusion system for 3D object detection. Based on modality-specific features, FastBEVFusion projects these features into semi-aligned modality-specific BEV spaces, without relying on a computationally intensive and potentially error-prone depth estimation. Given these BEV spaces, we propose a light-weight, soft, and dynamic fusion module based on cross-attention, which adapts dynamically to the scene context and enables feature fusion across the entire BEV spaces. Experiments on the complex nuScenes dataset show that FastBEVFusion outperforms state-of-the-art real-time systems, and achieves over 50 FPS without deployment libraries. Additionally, our system shows strong robustness to calibration errors, making FastBEVFusion a powerful 3D object detection system for real-world applications.
tldr: FastBEVFusion is a multi-modal 3D object detection system for autonomous driving that projects LiDAR and camera features into semi-aligned BEV spaces and fuses them via a light-weight cross-attention module, achieving over 50 FPS on nuScenes without deployment libraries.
tldr_zh: FastBEVFusion是一种用于自动驾驶的多模态3D目标检测系统，将激光雷达和相机特征投影到半对齐的BEV空间中，并通过轻量级交叉注意力模块进行融合，在nuScenes上无需部署库即可达到50 FPS以上。
summary_zh: 基于激光雷达和摄像头数据的可靠实时三维目标检测对于自动驾驶的安全性至关重要，系统必须能够在最小延迟内准确感知周围环境。许多最先进的系统能够实现高质量的检测结果，但往往无法满足实时性要求，限制了其实际应用。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了FastBEVFusion，一种简单、快速且稳健的三维目标检测融合系统。基于各模态特有的特征，FastBEVFusion将特征投影到半对齐的模态特定鸟瞰图（BEV）空间中，而无需依赖计算量大且可能引入误差的深度估计。在这些BEV空间的基础上，我们提出了一种基于交叉注意力的轻量级、软性且动态的融合模块，该模块能够根据场景上下文动态调整，并支持整个BEV空间上的特征融合。在复杂的nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，FastBEVFusion优于最先进的实时系统，并且在不使用部署库的情况下实现了超过50帧每秒的处理速度。此外，我们的系统对校准误差表现出较强的鲁棒性，使得FastBEVFusion成为适用于实际应用场景的强大三维目标检测系统。

title: Structure-Actuation Co-Design of All-Electric Heavy-Duty Robotic Manipulators
summary: This paper presents a mixed discrete-continuous multiobjective bilevel framework for the structure-actuation co-design of all-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators. The upper level optimizes manipulator geometry and actuation topology, while joint-specific lower-level searches construct feasible archives of discrete motor, gearbox, and screw configurations. A system-level coordinator selects actuator packages according to hardware mass, co-design cost, and loss-aware supply energy, and the resulting actuator masses are fed back to the robot model until a mass-consistent fixed point is obtained. Evaluation on a full-pose SE(3) benchmark with a 100-kg tool payload yields eight feasible nondominated designs, all satisfying the 12 prescribed poses. Actuator-mass coupling converges in three iterations for every reported design. A fixed-design ablation shows that one-pass sequential sizing changes hardware mass by up to 2.13%, co-design cost by 10.20%, and supply energy by 9.40% in magnitude. Payload screening further reveals increasing mass-cost-energy demand and changes in competitive mechanism topology with carried load.
tldr: This paper presents a bilevel optimization framework for co-designing the structure and actuation of all-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators, achieving mass-consistent designs under payload and pose constraints with notable reductions in hardware mass, cost, and energy compared to sequential design.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种双层优化框架，用于全电动重型机械臂的结构与驱动协同设计，在载荷和位姿约束下实现质量一致的设计，相较顺序设计在硬件质量、成本和能量上有显著降低。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向全电动重型机器人操作臂结构-驱动协同设计的混合离散-连续多目标双层优化框架。上层优化操作臂几何构型与驱动拓扑，而下层针对各关节的搜索过程则构建包含离散电机、减速器及丝杠配置的可行解档案。系统级协调器根据硬件质量、协同设计成本及考虑损耗的供能需求选取驱动组件，并将所得驱动质量反馈至机器人模型，直至获得质量一致的不动点。在承载100千克工具载荷的全位姿SE(3)基准测试中，该方法生成了八个可行的非支配设计方案，全部满足预设的12个位姿要求。所有上报设计的驱动-质量耦合均在三次迭代内收敛。固定设计消融实验表明，单次顺序选型可使硬件质量变化幅度达2.13%，协同设计成本变化10.20%，供能需求变化9.40%。载荷筛选进一步揭示出质量-成本-能量需求随负载增加而上升的趋势，以及竞争性机构拓扑随承载载荷发生变化的现象。

title: Omni-IGN: Onboard Image-Goal Navigation for Drones with Omnidirectional Vision
summary: Image-goal navigation (ImageNav) requires an agent to reach a location specified by a goal image in an unknown environment. For drones, this task demands exploration, goal- directed navigation, and collision avoidance under limited onboard computing resources. Existing aerial ImageNav methods are built on single-view observations, requiring additional rotation and exploration to search for goal-relevant cues outside the field of view. In this paper, we present Omni-IGN, a fully onboard ImageNav system that integrates quad-fisheye perception, an attention-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy, and a collision-aware safety layer. The policy adaptively fuses goal-relevant features across multiple views to provide directional guidance for continuous navigation. The quad-fisheye RGB images support both ImageNav and obstacle avoidance without a dedicated depth sensor. On Habitat benchmarks, Omni-IGN achieves the best performance among continuous-action baselines. Moreover, flight tests in IsaacSim validate the effectiveness of integrating learning-based depth estimation with the action safety layer for collision avoidance. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer without any fine-tuning or external localization. The code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: Omni-IGN presents a fully onboard image-goal navigation system for drones using quad-fisheye perception and an attention-based RL policy, achieving state-of-the-art performance in Habitat benchmarks and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: Omni-IGN 提出了一种用于无人机图像目标导航的全机载系统，利用四鱼眼感知和基于注意力的强化学习策略，在 Habitat 基准上达到最优性能，并实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体在未知环境中到达由目标图像指定的位置。对于无人机而言，该任务需要在有限机载计算资源下完成探索、目标导向导航及避障。现有空中ImageNav方法基于单视角观测，需要额外的旋转与探索来搜索视野之外的目标相关线索。本文提出Omni-IGN，一种全机载ImageNav系统，集成了四目鱼眼感知、基于注意力机制的强化学习（RL）策略以及碰撞感知安全层。该策略自适应地融合多视角下的目标相关特征，为连续导航提供方向引导。四目鱼眼RGB图像同时支持ImageNav与避障功能，无需专用深度传感器。在Habitat基准上，Omni-IGN在连续动作基线方法中取得了最优性能。此外，IsaacSim中的飞行测试验证了将基于学习的深度估计与动作安全层相结合进行避障的有效性。最后，真实世界实验展示了无需任何微调或外部定位的零样本仿真到现实迁移能力。代码与模型检查点将在论文被接收后发布。

title: When Black-Box Robot Policies Fail: Online Sensor Diagnosis and Repair with a Transparent Surrogate
summary: Robot foundation models may generalize across tasks and embodiments, but their actions still depend on sensors that can fail. When the policy is frozen or inaccessible, can an external monitor diagnose and repair corrupted inputs without access to its internals? We test a structured surrogate that separates periodic gait from sensor-dependent corrections to guide input repair around a frozen locomotion policy. On simulated Go2, offline diagnosis raises walking success from 259/640 to 429/640 episodes; online repair reaches 382/640, with no triggers in 64 held-out fault-free episodes. A matched boosted-tree surrogate predicts clean actions similarly well but yields no detected repair improvement over no repair. Separate fits improve walking on Go1 and ANYmal C, although phase-aware gradients perform better. Evidence remains limited to one policy and a partly screened simulated fault suite; robot foundation model and hardware validation remain open.
tldr: The paper proposes a transparent surrogate model to diagnose and repair corrupted sensor inputs for frozen black-box locomotion policies, showing improved walking success on simulated quadruped robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出用一种透明替代模型来诊断和修复冻结黑盒运动策略的损坏传感器输入，在仿真四足机器人上提高了行走成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型可能跨任务和本体进行泛化，但其动作仍依赖于可能失效的传感器。当策略被冻结或不可访问时，外部监视器能否在不访问其内部机制的情况下诊断并修复受损输入？我们测试了一种结构化替代模型，将周期性步态与依赖传感器的修正分离，以指导冻结运动策略周围的输入修复。在模拟Go2上，离线诊断将行走成功率从259/640个回合提升至429/640个回合；在线修复达到382/640个回合，且在64个留出的无故障回合中未触发修复。匹配的提升树替代模型对清洁动作的预测表现同样良好，但相较于不修复并未检测到修复改进。在Go1和ANYmal C上的独立拟合提升了行走表现，尽管相位感知梯度表现更佳。证据仍局限于单一策略及部分筛选的模拟故障集；机器人基础模型与硬件验证仍有待开展。

title: A fully articulated humanoid dexterous hand with human-level joint structure enabled by linkage-based actuation
summary: Humanoid dexterous hands are a core component of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to translate high-level intent into rich and adaptive physical interaction. However, existing designs remain constrained by a persistent trade-off among anthropomorphic kinematic complexity, mechanical robustness, load capacity and control simplicity, limiting dexterous manipulation in unstructured environments. Here we present Torch-Hand, a fully articulated humanoid dexterous hand that replicates the joint structure and motion hierarchy of the human hand with 21 degrees of freedom (DOF), comprising a highly articulated five-DOF thumb and four DOF in each of the remaining fingers. The differentiated thumb integrates multi-axis CMC motion to provide broad opposition and flexible contact orientation relative to the four fingers. Unlike tendon-driven or hybrid actuation approaches, Torch-Hand adopts an entirely linkage-based transmission architecture. By integrating screw-linkage actuation, the hand achieves high grasping force and substantial payload capacity while maintaining a compact anthropomorphic form. Its actuation architecture is optimized for control tractability, with all actuators integrated within the palm and arranged in a serial-robot-like configuration that establishes a direct correspondence between motor motion and joint kinematics. This architecture mechanically decouples functional DOF to reduce unintended inter-joint motion propagation, while allowing independently addressable DOF to be actively coordinated into coupled multi-joint motion patterns during complex manipulation. Comprehensive experiments assess reachable workspace, coordinated fingertip trajectories, thumb opposition, 33-grasp taxonomy coverage, grasping force, payload capacity and task-level manipulation. These results establish Torch-Hand as a robust hardware foundation for dexterous embodied manipulation.
tldr: Torch-Hand is a fully articulated humanoid dexterous hand with 21 DOF and linkage-based actuation, achieving human-level joint structure, high load capacity, and control tractability for robust embodied manipulation.
tldr_zh: Torch-Hand是一款全关节人形灵巧手，具有21个自由度并采用连杆驱动，实现了类人的关节结构、高负载能力和易控制性，为灵巧操作提供了坚实的硬件基础。
summary_zh: 类人灵巧手是具身智能的核心组成部分，使机器人能够将高层意图转化为丰富且自适应的物理交互。然而，现有设计仍受制于拟人运动学复杂度、机械鲁棒性、负载能力与控制简易性之间的持续权衡，限制了非结构化环境中的灵巧操作能力。本文提出Torch-Hand——一款全关节化的类人灵巧手，其复现了人手的关节结构与运动层级，具有21个自由度（DOF），包括高度关节化的五指拇指和其余四指各四个自由度。差异化的拇指集成了多轴腕掌（CMC）运动，提供了相对于四指的广泛对掌范围与灵活接触姿态。与腱驱动或混合驱动方案不同，Torch-Hand采用全连杆传动架构。通过集成螺旋连杆驱动，该手在保持紧凑拟人形态的同时实现了高抓取力与显著负载能力。其驱动架构针对控制易处理性进行了优化，所有驱动器集成于掌心内部，并以类似串联机器人的构型排布，建立了电机运动与关节运动学之间的直接对应关系。该架构在机械层面解耦了功能自由度，以减少非预期的关节间运动传播，同时允许独立寻址的自由度在复杂操作过程中被主动协调为耦合的多关节运动模式。综合实验评估了可达工作空间、协调指尖轨迹、拇指对掌、33种抓取分类覆盖、抓取力、负载能力及任务级操作性能。这些结果确立了Torch-Hand作为灵巧具身操作的稳健硬件基础。

title: On Shaky Ground: Characterising Non-Rigid Base Effects in Mobile Manipulation
summary: Mobile robot manipulators extend contact-task capability beyond the workspace of fixed robot installations, but their bases must also sustain the forces generated by the task. On lightweight platforms, base motion and support compliance can change the force and motion realised at the workpiece. How these non-rigid base effects manifest during sustained contact remains insufficiently characterised. This paper investigates non-rigid base effects in mobile robot manipulators through a sanding case study combining exploratory simulation with experiments on two lightweight, unactuated wheeled testbeds. Joint measurements of contact force, tool motion, and base vibration show that sustained contact coexisted with substantial task error: under low base-ground resistance, only 54-70% of a 100 N command was realised, with tool-centre-point errors reaching 100 mm. Increasing base-ground resistance during contact improved force realisation and arrested further tool displacement, while base vibration did not vary consistently with force-tracking error in the tested conditions. These observations illustrate how non-rigid base behaviour can affect contact-task execution and highlight the value of examining force, motion, and vibration together when characterising lightweight mobile manipulation.
tldr: This paper characterizes how non-rigid bases in lightweight mobile manipulators affect contact-task performance, using a sanding case study with simulations and real robot experiments, showing that base compliance leads to significant force and trajectory errors that can be partially mitigated by increasing base-ground resistance.
tldr_zh: 本文通过打磨案例研究，结合仿真与真实实验，表征了轻型移动机械臂非刚性底座对接触任务性能的影响，表明底座柔性导致显著的力与轨迹误差，而增加底座-地面阻力可部分缓解该问题。
summary_zh: 移动机器人操作臂将接触任务的能力扩展到了固定机器人安装的工作空间之外，但其基座也必须承受任务所产生的力。在轻量化平台上，基座运动及支撑柔顺性会改变工件处实际实现的力与运动。在持续接触过程中，这些非刚性基座效应如何表现仍未被充分表征。本文通过一项打磨案例研究，结合探索性仿真与在两种轻量化、非驱动轮式试验台上的实验，探讨了移动机器人操作臂中的非刚性基座效应。接触力、工具运动及基座振动的联合测量结果表明，持续接触伴随着显著的任务误差：在低基座-地面阻力条件下，100 N指令力仅实现了54%-70%，工具中心点误差达到100 mm。接触过程中增大基座-地面阻力可改善力的实现，并阻止工具进一步位移，而在所测试条件下，基座振动与力跟踪误差之间没有一致的变化关系。这些观察结果说明了非刚性基座行为如何影响接触任务的执行，并凸显了在表征轻量化移动操作时，将力、运动与振动联合考察的价值。

title: From Biological Curves to Soft Modular Robots: Learning-Based Inverse Design with Uncertainty-Guided Refinement
summary: Animals exhibit diverse shape-changing behaviors, from the undulatory swimming of eels to the arching movements of inchworms. Reproducing these biological shapes with modular soft robots offers a promising approach to developing versatile bioinspired robotic systems. However, translating a desired shape into a feasible robotic configuration remains challenging. Existing cable-driven modular soft robots rely on computationally expensive physics-based modeling and combinatorial search for inverse design, making it difficult to efficiently reproduce diverse target shapes. To address this challenge, we present a learning-based real-to-sim-to-real framework that translates biological curves into robotic configurations through surrogate-assisted inverse design and uncertainty-guided refinement. The proposed method combines learned inverse prediction with targeted candidate exploration, using a fast forward surrogate to evaluate and select suitable designs. The learned forward surrogate reduces deformation prediction time from $1.53 \times 10^5$ ms to 0.0008 ms, achieving approximately a $1.9 \times 10^8$-fold speedup. At the same time, the proposed inverse design method reduces design time from $1.99 \times 10^6$ ms to 4.18 ms. On 5,000 test samples generated from previously unseen threading patterns, the method achieves a 93% shape reconstruction success rate under surrogate-based evaluation. Physical demonstrations with four bioinspired robots further illustrate the translation of biological curves into realizable robotic shapes.
tldr: This paper presents a learning-based inverse design framework for translating biological curves into configurations of modular soft robots, using a surrogate forward model and uncertainty-guided refinement to achieve massive speedups and high shape reconstruction success rates, with physical demonstrations on four bioinspired robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于学习逆向设计框架，将生物曲线转化为模块化软机器人配置，利用代理前向模型和不确定性引导细化实现大幅加速和高形状重建成功率，并在四个仿生机器人上进行了物理验证。
summary_zh: 动物展现出多种形态变化行为，从鳗鱼的波动游动到尺蠖的拱形运动不等。利用模块化软体机器人复现这些生物形态，为开发多功能仿生机器人系统提供了一种前景广阔的方法。然而，将目标形态转化为可行的机器人构型仍然是一项挑战。现有的缆驱动模块化软体机器人在逆向设计中依赖计算成本高昂的基于物理的建模和组合搜索，难以高效复现多样化的目标形态。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于学习的“真实-仿真-真实”框架，通过代理辅助逆向设计和不确定性引导的精化，将生物曲线转化为机器人构型。该方法将学习得到的逆向预测与定向候选探索相结合，利用快速前向代理评估并筛选合适的设计方案。所学习的前向代理将变形预测时间从$1.53 \times 10^5$毫秒缩短至0.0008毫秒，实现了约$1.9 \times 10^8$倍的加速。同时，所提出的逆向设计方法将设计时间从$1.99 \times 10^6$毫秒缩短至4.18毫秒。在由未见穿线模式生成的5,000个测试样本上，该方法在基于代理的评估下实现了93%的形态重建成功率。四个仿生机器人的物理演示进一步展示了将生物曲线转化为可实现机器人形态的有效性。

title: SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) enable world models to plan from images by predicting future embeddings. However, their visual prediction objectives do not explicitly incorporate task-relevant state information, so the physical state that determines task progress may not be reliably captured in the latent space. Supervising world models with simulator state can make planning more informative, but it requires deciding which state features matter. Features are typically selected by hand or weighted uniformly, and a uniform weighting gives every standardized state feature equal influence, so redundant coordinates can overcount the same variation, while irrelevant ones can obscure task-relevant differences. To address this limitation, we propose SWIM (State Weighting with Inverse-Dynamics Model), which learns state weights from offline trajectories by predicting recorded actions from current states and observed future displacements. The learned weights quantify each feature's contribution to action prediction and define a weighted state metric for state-supervised training, which we demonstrate by aligning latent and state distances. The inverse-dynamics model is used only during training, so the resulting world model plans from images with no additional planning-time computation. Across five simulated robotic manipulation tasks, SWIM consistently improves planning success over uniform state weighting.
tldr: SWIM learns state feature weights from offline trajectories using an inverse-dynamics model, improving JEPA world model planning in robotic manipulation by aligning latent and state distances.
tldr_zh: SWIM利用逆动力学模型从离线轨迹中学习状态特征权重，通过对齐潜在距离和状态距离来提升JEPA世界模型在机器人操作中的规划性能。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）使世界模型能够通过预测未来嵌入来从图像中进行规划。然而，其视觉预测目标并未显式纳入与任务相关的状态信息，因此决定任务进展的物理状态可能无法在潜空间中被可靠捕获。使用模拟器状态对世界模型进行监督可以使规划更具信息性，但这需要确定哪些状态特征至关重要。特征通常通过人工选择或均匀加权，而均匀加权会使每个标准化状态特征具有相同的影响力，从而冗余坐标可能重复计算同一变化，而不相关特征则可能掩盖任务相关差异。为解决这一局限，我们提出SWIM（基于逆动力学模型的状态加权），该方法通过从当前状态和观测到的未来位移预测记录动作，从离线轨迹中学习状态权重。学习到的权重量化了每个特征对动作预测的贡献，并定义了用于状态监督训练的加权状态度量，我们通过对齐潜距离与状态距离对此进行了验证。逆动力学模型仅在训练期间使用，因此所得世界模型在规划时仅需图像输入，无需额外计算开销。在五个模拟机器人操作任务中，SWIM consistently相较于均匀状态加权显著提升了规划成功率。

title: OpenJaws: An Open Hardware UMI Framework with Stereo Localization for Generalist Manipulation
summary: Handheld data-collection interfaces such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) allow manipulation demonstrations to be gathered in the wild without a robot in the loop, but the quality of the resulting action labels is bounded by the accuracy of vision-based localization. Existing systems recover end-effector pose from monocular visual-inertial odometry, which is subject to scale ambiguity and drift, or delegate tracking to closed-source modules and external infrastructure that reintroduce cost and setup burden. We present OpenJaws, a fully open hardware and software framework for sensorized UMI that improves localization and simplifies deployment across robot platforms. OpenJaws pairs a modular, 3D-printed gripper exposing a standardized ISO adapter with a low-cost stereo camera to recover metric camera trajectories. We further introduce UMI-Loc-Bench-v1, a benchmark quantifying real-world localization accuracy for handheld data-collection devices, and show that stereo localization substantially outperforms monocular alternatives. Finally, we demonstrate that policies trained on data collected with OpenJaws can be deployed on a real robot across multiple tasks. Hardware, software, and data are released under a commercially permissive license. Code, data, and videos are available at https://open-jaws.github.io/
tldr: OpenJaws is an open hardware and software framework for a sensorized UMI gripper that uses a low-cost stereo camera to improve metric localization accuracy for handheld data collection, and demonstrates that policies trained with this data can be deployed on real robots.
tldr_zh: OpenJaws 是一个开放硬件和软件框架，用于传感化的 UMI 夹爪，利用低成本立体相机提高手持数据采集的度量定位精度，并展示了使用该数据训练的策略可部署到真实机器人上。
summary_zh: 手持式数据采集接口（如通用操控接口，UMI）使得无需机器人参与即可在真实环境中收集操控演示数据，但生成的动作标签质量受限于基于视觉的定位精度。现有系统通过单目视觉-惯性里程计恢复末端执行器位姿，这存在尺度模糊和漂移问题，或依赖闭源模块和外部基础设施进行跟踪，从而重新引入成本和部署负担。我们提出OpenJaws，一个完全开源软硬件框架，用于增强UMI的定位能力并简化其在多种机器人平台上的部署。OpenJaws将模块化的3D打印夹爪（配备标准化ISO接口）与低成本立体相机相结合，以恢复公制相机轨迹。我们进一步推出UMI-Loc-Bench-v1基准，用于量化手持数据采集设备在真实场景中的定位精度，并证明立体定位显著优于单目方案。最后，我们展示了使用OpenJaws采集的数据训练的策略可部署到真实机器人上完成多种任务。硬件、软件和数据均以商业许可协议发布。代码、数据和视频可在https://open-jaws.github.io/获取。

title: HIDRA: Hierarchical Dual-Routing Attention for Replay-Free Lifelong Imitation Learning
summary: Robotic agents operating in real-world environments must adapt continuously from a stream of multimodal demonstrations, often under constraints that preclude storing or revisiting past data. In this replay-free, single-pass lifelong imitation learning setting, sequential updates can progressively distort the representation space, making expert-based approaches particularly sensitive to routing interference, causing expert selection to degrade over time. We propose HIDRA, a structured routing framework that mitigates this issue through a hierarchical dual-attention mechanism, which decouples instruction-level expert retrieval from context-dependent refinement. To further stabilize routing under representation drift, HIDRA introduces a key-level geometric regularization that enforces both alignment within tasks and separation across tasks. The resulting approach enables reliable expert selection while supporting an expandable set of experts for continual adaptation. We evaluate HIDRA on several LIBERO benchmark suites, including more challenging variants with heterogeneous task sequences and paraphrased language instructions. Our approach consistently outperforms both replay-free and replay-based baselines, improving AUC and forward transfer while maintaining low forgetting, with stronger gains under high interference and language variation. The code is available at: https://github.com/yfqi/HIDRA.
tldr: HIDRA introduces a hierarchical dual-routing attention mechanism with key-level geometric regularization to enable replay-free lifelong imitation learning for robotic manipulation, improving expert selection stability and performance across diverse LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: HIDRA 提出了一种分层双路由注意力机制和键级几何正则化，以实现在无重放条件下的机器人终身模仿学习，提升专家选择的稳定性和在多样LIBERO基准上的性能。
summary_zh: 在真实世界环境中运行的机器人智能体必须持续从多模态示范流中适应，且往往受制于无法存储或重访历史数据的约束。在这种无回放、单遍终身模仿学习场景下，顺序更新会逐步扭曲表征空间，使得基于专家的方法对路由干扰尤为敏感，导致专家选择性能随时间退化。我们提出HIDRA，一种结构化路由框架，通过分层双注意力机制缓解该问题，将指令级专家检索与上下文相关的细化过程解耦。为进一步在表征漂移下稳定路由，HIDRA引入键级几何正则化，既强化任务内对齐，又增强任务间分离。所提方法在保证可靠专家选择的同时，支持可扩展的专家集合以进行持续适应。我们在多个LIBERO基准套件上评估HIDRA，包括更具挑战性的异构任务序列和改述语言指令变体。我们的方法在无回放和有回放基线上均持续取得更优性能，提升AUC和前向迁移指标，同时保持低遗忘率，在高干扰和语言变化情境下增益更为显著。代码已开源：https://github.com/yfqi/HIDRA。

title: cuArms: GPU-Accelerated Conflict-Based Planning for Multi-Arm Manipulation
summary: Multi-arm manipulation has the potential to dramatically improve the throughput, efficiency, and dexterity of many manipulation tasks. Recent work coordinates multiple robot arms in a shared workcell by allocating and scheduling tasks for greater parallelism, jointly planning multi-arm motions, or directly learning multi-arm policies. So far, these approaches are either too slow, rely on domain-specific assumptions, or scale poorly with the number of robots and task horizon. Thus, we introduce cuArms, a conflict-based planner co-designed with GPU parallelism that efficiently decomposes the search space using reusable multi-modal roadmaps for individual robots and resolves conflicts and deadlocks through a lazy search. To jointly optimize task assignment, schedules, motions, and manipulation skills, we integrate a high-level scheduler that proposes candidate skeletons for cuArms to ground into coordinated manipulation plans. Experimental results show that our method establishes a new state of the art, with real-time initial solutions and anytime improvements in both motion quality and scheduling, without days of domain-specific training required by learning approaches. Videos of both simulated and real-world industrial tasks are available on https://cuarms.github.io/.
tldr: cuArms introduces a GPU-accelerated conflict-based planner that efficiently coordinates multi-arm manipulation by decomposing the search space with multi-modal roadmaps and using a lazy search to resolve conflicts, achieving real-time initial solutions and anytime improvements in motion quality and scheduling.
tldr_zh: cuArms 提出了一种基于GPU加速的冲突规划器，通过多模态路图分解搜索空间并采用惰性搜索解决冲突，从而高效协调多臂操作，实现实时初始解和运动质量与调度的持续改进。
summary_zh: 多臂操控有潜力显著提升众多操控任务的处理量、效率和灵巧性。近期研究通过在共享工作单元中分配和调度任务以实现更高程度的并行性，联合规划多臂运动，或直接学习多臂策略来协调多个机械臂的运作。迄今为止，这些方法要么速度过慢，要么依赖于特定领域的假设，要么在机器人数量增加和任务周期延长时扩展性不佳。为此，我们提出了cuArms，一种与GPU并行性协同设计的基于冲突的规划器，它利用针对单个机器人的可重用多模态路线图高效地分解搜索空间，并通过惰性搜索解决冲突和死锁问题。为联合优化任务分配、调度、运动和操作技能，我们集成了一种高层调度器，其提出候选骨架供cuArms落地为协调操控计划。实验结果表明，我们的方法确立了新的最先进水平，在无需学习方法所需的数日领域特定训练的情况下，实现了实时初始解和运动质量与调度两方面的随时改进。模拟和真实世界工业任务的视频可访问 https://cuarms.github.io/ 观看。

title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
summary: World models are widely proposed as core components for enabling agents to reason over long temporal and spatial horizons. Yet current evaluations often emphasize task performance while providing limited insight into whether learned world models acquire predictive latent dynamics that reflect the underlying structure of the environment. Here we introduce the concept of faithful latent world models as an equivariance condition between the environment's transition map and the learned latent dynamics. We propose latent rollout consistency (LRC) as a metric to evaluate action-conditioned latent prediction. Strikingly, we find that across the studied state of the art latent world models, none solves the task by actually faithfully modeling the dynamics of the environment.
tldr: This paper proposes faithful latent world models and a latent rollout consistency (LRC) metric to evaluate whether latent world models truly learn predictive dynamics, finding that current state-of-the-art models fail to faithfully model environment dynamics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出潜在世界模型的忠实性概念以及潜变量滚动一致性（LRC）指标，用以评估潜在世界模型是否真正学习环境的预测动力学，结果发现现有最先进模型均未忠实地建模环境动态。
summary_zh: 世界模型被广泛提出作为使代理能够在长时间和空间跨度上进行推理的核心组件。然而，当前的评估往往侧重于任务表现，而对于所学世界模型是否获得了反映环境潜在结构的预测性潜在动态，提供的洞察却十分有限。在此，我们引入忠实潜在世界模型的概念，将其定义为环境转移映射与所学潜在动态之间的等变性条件。我们提出潜在展开一致性（LRC）作为评估动作条件潜在预测的指标。值得注意的是，我们发现，在所研究的最先进的潜在世界模型中，没有一种模型通过真正忠实地建模环境动态来解决任务。

title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.
tldr: The paper introduces a benchmark and a method to study how different visual representations (RGB, depth, panoramic, top-down) affect spatial reasoning from imagined states, showing that RGB alone is insufficient and adaptive representation selection improves reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基准和方法，研究不同视觉表征（RGB、深度、全景、俯视）对想象状态空间推理的影响，表明仅用RGB不足，自适应选择表征可提升推理。
summary_zh: 视觉世界模型日益通过生成未观测状态的RGB视图来支持空间推理。然而，RGB之所以成为默认接口，很大程度上是因为它更适用于视觉生成，而非必然是最有利于下游推理的表示形式。不同的空间问题可能受益于同一想象状态的不同表示：俯视几何有助于全局距离比较，而全景视图则为开放空间推理提供更广泛的上下文。为隔离表示在空间想象中的作用，我们引入了ImagiRep，一个基于模拟器的基准测试，包含922个问题，涵盖两种设置（视角想象与跨视图整合）下的七种问题类型，为同一未观测状态提供oracle RGB及六种替代表示（如深度图、全景视图和俯视几何）。这一受控比较揭示，即使想象的RGB完全准确，也不能保证空间推理的准确性，且不同类型的问题受益于不同的表示形式。由世界模型估计状态导出的表示也呈现类似趋势。值得注意的是，仅靠估计的RGB可能误导空间推理，而替代表示则保留互补优势。基于这些发现，我们提出了GEARS，一种轻量级的测试时自适应表示选择策略，其性能优于现有空间想象方法，并表明对未见状态的推理所需远不止生成RGB视图。

title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
summary: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.
tldr: This paper introduces EvidenceConnect, a data synthesis framework that trains VLMs to connect visual evidence from zoomed regions, improving performance on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, and agent tasks without task-specific data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出EvidenceConnect数据合成框架，通过训练VLM连接图像局部区域的视觉证据，提升了具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解和智能体任务的泛化性能。
summary_zh: 多模态感知构成多模态智能的基础。其中，空间感知与多模态长上下文理解是支撑具身智能和多模态智能体的两项关键任务。然而，为这些任务合成针对性、高质量的训练数据仍然困难且成本高昂。我们的核心洞察在于，这些任务共享一种底层能力，我们称之为“证据连接”：识别相关视觉事实，将其绑定到正确的实体，恢复实体间的关系，并将这些信息整合为答案。关键在于，针对这一能力合成训练数据远比针对任务本身合成数据容易得多。为强化该能力，我们提出EvidenceConnect——一种易于实现的数据合成框架，利用单张图像内相关区域的缩放视图来生成需要视觉证据比较、聚合或串联的问题。为确保质量，仅当多个独立视觉语言模型对参考答案达成一致时才予以保留，同时通过区域消融测试剔除那些在移除选定区域后答案仍然成立的问题。随后，我们使用强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）在生成的数据上训练基础视觉语言模型，得到Zooming without Zooming v2（ZwZ2）。尽管合成数据并非针对任何下游基准定制，ZwZ2仍显著提升了细粒度与空间感知能力，并在具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态智能体任务及通用视觉推理方面取得了进一步增益。这些结果确立了EvidenceConnect作为证据连接监督的有效框架，并表明强化这一共享能力可带来更具泛化性的多模态感知。

title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
summary: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent's interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce Dwell, a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that reframes a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, endowing it with the ability to predict, adjust, and act in latent space. Leveraging the VLM's own representations and its dual role as both world model and policy, the agent continually learns from real interactions to anticipate and evaluate action outcomes, and from latent imagination to improve its behavior. Across five interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves the strongest overall performance among trainable methods while substantially reducing the compute required for imagination, showing that effective world models for VLM agents need not reconstruct the future; they need to predict futures that are useful for action. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell
tldr: Dwell frames a pretrained VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator for model-based RL, enabling continual learning from real interactions and latent imagination without reconstructing the future, achieving strong performance across five interactive visual environments with reduced compute.
tldr_zh: Dwell将预训练VLM作为循环潜在转移算子，用于基于模型的强化学习，使智能体能够从真实交互和潜在想象中持续学习而无需重建未来，在五个交互式视觉环境中以更低计算量取得强性能。
summary_zh: 从经验中学习对于构建能够持续扩展能力的下一代智能体至关重要。预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）已经内化了丰富的世界知识，但这些知识很少被利用来通过在线交互驱动策略改进。高效实现这一潜力仍然具有挑战性，因为策略更新会改变智能体的交互分布，要求世界模型相应调整，而持续更新大型预训练模型在计算上代价高昂。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了Dwell，一种基于模型的强化学习（RL）框架，将视觉-语言模型重新构建为循环隐式转移算子，赋予其在隐空间中预测、调整和行动的能力。利用VLM自身的表示及其作为世界模型和策略的双重角色，智能体持续从真实交互中学习以预测和评估行动结果，并通过隐式想象来改进其行为。在五个交互式视觉环境中，Dwell在可训练方法中取得了最强的整体性能，同时大幅减少了想象所需的计算量，表明有效的VLM智能体世界模型无需重建未来；它们需要预测的是对行动有用的未来。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell

title: Evaluation-Guided Demonstration Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies: The Winning Entry in the MetaFine Open Competition
summary: We fine-tuned a separate $π_{0.5}$ policy for each of the five tasks in the MetaFine Open Competition, with a task-specific training mixture and number of actions executed per prediction. Training started from the official demonstrations and expert procedures. Local evaluation exposed recurring grasping, pushing, and insertion failures. We addressed them by revising the demonstrated motions and by adding expert continuations from states the policy reached, while keeping nominal demonstrations in training. Checkpoints were compared on every instruction, so that a gain on one instruction could not hide a loss on another. Our submission, MAI, ranked first overall with a score of 96.66.
tldr: The paper describes the winning approach in the MetaFine Open Competition, which fine-tunes separate VLA policies per task and refines demonstrations based on local evaluation feedback to fix recurring failures, achieving a score of 96.66.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了MetaFine开放竞赛中的获胜方法，即为每个任务微调独立的VLA策略，并根据局部评估反馈改进演示以修复常见故障，最终获得96.66分。
summary_zh: 我们针对MetaFine公开竞赛中的五个任务，分别为每个任务微调了一个独立的\( \pi_{0.5} \)策略，采用了针对特定任务的训练混合数据以及每次预测执行的动作数量。训练从官方演示和专家流程开始。局部评估暴露了反复出现的抓取、推动和插入失败问题。我们通过修改演示动作，并从策略所达到的状态中添加专家延续步骤，同时将标准演示保留在训练中，解决了这些问题。我们对每个指令的检查点进行了比较，以确保一个指令上的改进不会掩盖另一个指令上的退步。我们的提交方案MAI以96.66的总分排名第一。

title: BoxWorld: Let World Engines Control and Video Generators Render
summary: We tackle the challenge of building real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined behaviors. Such worlds must track object states, apply interaction rules, and render the resulting consequences as users act. Yet existing end-to-end video world models typically learn interaction dynamics within the generator, making it difficult to specify object-level rules and reason about their consequences. In this work, we introduce BoxWorld, which separates interaction reasoning from generative rendering. Given user-specified rules, a coding agent creates a Box World Engine that determines interaction outcomes and exposes the resulting object states through a lightweight interface of layout boxes, persistent object attributes, and dynamic status variables, leaving appearance and physical effects to generative rendering. A Box-State Generative Renderer then renders this evolving state stream into video autoregressively, enabling online control over object motion, state switches, and conditional events. Rendering this state stream is non-trivial: the renderer must respond to object-level state updates in real time while remaining coherent with the generated history. To this end, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that learns object grounding from open-domain videos and state transitions from gameplay videos, both annotated automatically, and finally performs rollout distillation on self-generated histories. We further propose PairedStateBench, a paired benchmark for fine-grained interaction control. BoxWorld substantially outperforms end-to-end world models and remains competitive across multiple public benchmarks. Project page: https://boxworld-web.github.io.
tldr: BoxWorld separates interaction reasoning (via a rule-specified Box World Engine) from generative video rendering, enabling real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined object-level behaviors, and outperforms end-to-end world models on interaction control benchmarks.
tldr_zh: BoxWorld将交互推理（通过规则指定的Box World Engine）与生成式视频渲染分离，实现了具有用户定义对象级行为的实时交互视频世界，并在交互控制基准上优于端到端世界模型。
summary_zh: 我们致力于解决构建具备用户自定义行为的实时交互视频世界这一挑战。此类世界必须追踪对象状态、应用交互规则，并在用户操作时渲染相应的后果。然而，现有的端到端视频世界模型通常将交互动态学习内置于生成器中，这使得指定对象级规则并推理其后果变得困难。在本工作中，我们提出了BoxWorld，它将交互推理与生成式渲染相分离。根据用户指定的规则，一个编码智能体创建Box World引擎，该引擎确定交互结果，并通过轻量级接口（包括布局框、持久对象属性和动态状态变量）暴露所得的对象状态，而外观和物理效果则交由生成式渲染处理。随后，一个框状态生成式渲染器将这一不断演化的状态流自回归地渲染为视频，从而实现对对象运动、状态切换和条件事件的在线控制。渲染这一状态流并非易事：渲染器必须实时响应对象级状态更新，同时与已生成的历史保持连贯。为此，我们引入了一种三阶段训练策略，该策略从开放域视频中学习对象定位，从游戏视频中学习状态转换（两者均自动标注），最后在自生成的历史上进行展开蒸馏。我们进一步提出了PairedStateBench，一个用于细粒度交互控制的配对基准。BoxWorld显著优于端到端世界模型，并在多个公开基准上保持竞争力。项目页面：https://boxworld-web.github.io。

title: Hyperparameter and Neural Architecture Search via Evolutionary Optimization for Reinforcement Learning: HPNAS-RL
summary: In this study, we propose a dual-branch evolutionary framework that simultaneously performs Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) for Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Autonomous Driving (AD) tasks. While NAS has shown strong potential in automating architecture design for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), its application to RL remains limited, especially in scenarios that require joint optimization of architectural and training dynamics. Building on our prior work on Evolutionary Multi-Objective NAS (EMNAS), the proposed framework evolves discrete network architectures and continuous hyperparameters in parallel under a unified multi-objective search strategy. In this setup, NAS targets the convolutional layers of the RL policy network - responsible for visual feature extraction, while HPO focuses on optimizing critical RL hyperparameters. To accelerate convergence and improve generalization, we incorporate parallel evaluation and a teacher-student policy transfer mechanism.
